pitch: The testimony of a deported psychiatrist and the logotherapy born from it: human beings can find meaning in life even in the worst conditions.
br: The thesis: the will to meaning
quiz: What is the fundamental human motivation according to Frankl?
He calls it the will to meaning.
Which freedom remains, according to Frankl, even in the worst conditions?
The freedom to choose one's attitude
He did not judge those who no longer had the strength.
What are the three phases described in the camps?
Each with its own psychological reactions.
What did Frankl observe in prisoners who lost all hope in the future?
Hence his efforts to remind each person of what awaited them.
What are the three paths to meaning?
A work, an experience or encounter, an attitude toward the unavoidable
What we do, what we experience, how we bear what we must.
The feeling of meaninglessness common in modern societies
The “Sunday neurosis” is one form of it.
Doing the opposite of what you want
Wishing with humor for what you fear in order to detach from it
It breaks the cycle between fear and symptom.
What does Frankl say about happiness?
It ensues when you dedicate yourself to something greater than yourself
The more you seek it for its own sake, the more it eludes you.
